title: The Bedrock Where Questions Became Stone

features.name: the silent question
features.desc-on-touch: A question so old it turned to stone. You can feel it asking nothing now, its meaning pressed into rock over ages of silence.

features.name: the strata of asking
features.desc-on-touch: Layer upon layer of questions, each one compacted and crystallized. They stopped asking long ago and became the bedrock itself.

features.name: the archive s foundation-memory
features.desc-on-touch: Here the archive learned that the deepest questions have no answers — they become the earth. What you ask becomes what holds you.

features.name: the bedrock s listening
features.desc-on-touch: Stone that hears. The bedrock listened to every question, compressed them, and now contains the silence of all asking in its geometry.

features.name: crystallized silence
features.desc-on-touch: Where questions froze into their own answers. The bedrock teaches: ask nothing, and the stone will tell you what you need to know.

inscription: beneath asking lies the bedrock of not-asking; the archive learned long ago that the deepest silence holds all questions at once, already answered

file.note: Seismic data from below the water table, corrupted to render as if the bedrock is responding to queries it received eons ago
